name: Yatoon Restaurant Menu & Online Ordering
author: yatoon

sections.description:
Yatoon Restaurant Menu & Online Ordering lets restaurants publish a polished digital menu and accept orders directly from their WordPress site — no monthly SaaS fees, no commission cuts.

The free version is designed for restaurants that collect payment manually at pickup, delivery, or the table. For built-in online payments, SMS verification, and social login, upgrade to Yatoon Restaurant Menu Pro.

Free Features

Menu Display
* Beautiful responsive menu with item photos, descriptions, and prices
* Category navigation bar with sticky scrolling and mobile hamburger
* Featured items horizontal carousel (Uber Eats-style)
* Full-text search across item names, descriptions, and categories
* Item availability windows (e.g. lunch specials only 11 AM – 2 PM)
* Stock quantity control and max-per-order limits per item
* Modifier groups with required/optional options and per-option pricing (e.g. Size, Extras)
* Customizable colors, button styles, and font sizes from the admin

Ordering
* Pay-at-restaurant ordering for pickup, delivery, and dine-in
* Scheduled orders — customers can choose a later pickup time
* Tip options (configurable dollar amounts), tax rate, service fee, and delivery fee
* Coupon / promo code support (percent-off and fixed-amount)
* Email order confirmations sent to the customer
* Email order notifications sent to the restaurant
* Full cart drawer with item modifiers, quantity controls, and order notes
* Per-order coupon discount, totals breakdown at checkout

Operations
* Admin order management with one-click status updates (New → Preparing → Ready → Done)
* Kitchen Display screen ([yatoon_kitchen] shortcode and dedicated admin sidebar page)
* Customer-facing order status tracker ([yatoon_order_status] shortcode)
* Menu Items admin: add, edit, delete, sort, hide/show, featured toggle (⭐)
* Orders page with status count dashboard, search by customer name/phone/email, and filter by status and fulfillment type

Customer Accounts
* Native sign-in and registration using WordPress user accounts — no separate database table
* Save favorite items (❤️) and view order history from the account panel
* Checkout pre-fills saved name, phone, and email for returning customers

Pro Features

  • Stripe credit card payments (full Payment Element — supports 3D Secure, saved cards)
  • Apple Pay and Google Pay through Stripe
  • Alipay and WeChat Pay through Stripe (QR code flow for WeChat)
  • Stripe webhook recovery — order is still created if the customer closes the tab before confirmation returns
  • Twilio SMS phone verification at checkout (prevents fake orders)
  • Twilio SMS order status notifications to customers and the restaurant
  • Google, Facebook, and Instagram social login (OAuth)
  • Separate customer account table with avatar, phone verification status, and 30-day session tokens
  • Premium license management and automatic updates through Freemius

Shortcodes

  • [yatoon_menu] — Full menu with category nav, search, featured carousel, cart, and checkout
  • [yatoon_kitchen] — Real-time kitchen display with auto-refresh and High/Watch priority alerts
  • [yatoon_order_status] — Customer order status lookup by order number

Upgrade to Pro

Yatoon Restaurant Menu Pro is distributed outside WordPress.org through Freemius.

  1. In WordPress Admin go to Yatoon Restaurant Menu → Upgrade to Pro, or click Upgrade to Pro on the Plugins page
  2. Complete checkout through Freemius
  3. Download the Pro ZIP from your Freemius dashboard
  4. Deactivate Yatoon Restaurant Menu Free first
  5. Upload and activate Yatoon Restaurant Menu Pro
  6. Activate your Pro license in Yatoon Restaurant Menu → Account
  7. Configure Stripe, Twilio, and OAuth settings in Yatoon Restaurant Menu → Settings

Free and Pro must not be active at the same time. Both versions register the same database tables, AJAX endpoints, and shortcodes; activating both simultaneously would cause Cannot redeclare function errors. The free version detects when Pro is already active (and vice-versa), shows a clear admin notice, and refuses to load — so it is safe to upload the new version, but you should still deactivate the old version first to avoid the notice.

External Services

The free version operates fully within your own WordPress installation for menu display, ordering, and order management. It does not connect to payment providers, SMS providers, or social login providers.

Freemius SDK is bundled for opt-in licensing, account management, and upgrade flows in the WordPress admin. No data is sent to Freemius unless you choose to connect an account.
* Service: https://freemius.com/
* Terms: https://freemius.com/terms/
* Privacy: https://freemius.com/privacy/

Pro features can optionally connect to the following third-party services, all configured by the store owner and activated only after credentials are entered in Settings:
* Stripe (payments) — https://stripe.com/ — Stripe Privacy: https://stripe.com/privacy
* Twilio (SMS) — https://twilio.com/ — Twilio Privacy: https://www.twilio.com/en-us/legal/privacy
* Google Sign-In (OAuth) — https://developers.google.com/identity — Google Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
* Facebook Login (OAuth) — https://developers.facebook.com/ — Meta Privacy: https://www.facebook.com/privacy/policy/
* Instagram Basic Display (OAuth) — https://developers.facebook.com/docs/instagram-basic-display-api
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress Admin go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  2. Upload the plugin ZIP and click Install Now
  3. Click Activate Plugin
  4. Go to Yatoon Restaurant Menu → Settings to configure your restaurant info and ordering options
  5. Create or edit a page and add [yatoon_menu] to display your menu

Recommended pages to create:
* A Menu page with [yatoon_menu]
* A Kitchen page (staff-only, password-protected) with [yatoon_kitchen]
* An Order Status page (public) with [yatoon_order_status]
sections.faq:
Does the free version accept credit cards?

No. The free version accepts pay-at-restaurant orders only — customers place an order online and pay in person when they pick up, receive delivery, or dine in. Upgrade to Pro for Stripe, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Alipay, and WeChat Pay.

Does this plugin require third-party services?

No. Menu display, ordering, kitchen view, and order tracking all run inside WordPress with no external services required. Pro integrations (Stripe, Twilio, OAuth) are fully opt-in and only activated after you enter credentials in Settings.

Can customers track their order status?

Yes. Add [yatoon_order_status] to any public page. Customers enter their order number to see the current status (New, Preparing, Ready, Done) in real time.

How do I set up the kitchen screen for staff?

Go to Yatoon Restaurant Menu → Kitchen Display in the WordPress admin sidebar. You can also add [yatoon_kitchen] to a password-protected page so kitchen staff can access it on a tablet without logging into WordPress admin.

Can customers save favorites and reorder?

Yes. Enable Customer Accounts in Settings. Customers can register, sign in, save favorite items (❤️), and view their order history. Accounts use standard WordPress users — no extra database tables are needed in the free version.

Does this support modifiers like size, spice level, or add-ons?

Yes. Each menu item supports unlimited modifier groups. Each group has its own label (e.g. “Rice”, “Extras”), options with individual prices, a required/optional flag, and a max-selection limit. Modifiers are validated server-side when the order is placed.

Can I offer scheduled orders with a specific pickup time?

Yes. Enable Scheduled Orders in Settings. Customers can choose ASAP or pick a future time. You can set a Prep Time so the ASAP slot is always realistic.

Is there a limit on menu items, categories, or orders?

No. The plugin stores everything in your own WordPress database. There are no artificial item or order limits.

Will this conflict with other plugins?

Yatoon Restaurant Menu uses its own isolated database tables and option keys, so conflicts with unrelated plugins are unlikely. However, you should not activate Yatoon Restaurant Menu Free and Yatoon Restaurant Menu Pro simultaneously — both versions register the same tables, hooks, and shortcodes. The plugin detects this and refuses to double-load, but you should deactivate the old version before activating the new one.

Where do I report bugs or request features?

Please use the WordPress.org support forum for this plugin.
sections.changelog:
3.2.6

  • Updated plugin metadata and WordPress.org Plugin Check compatibility fixes.

3.2.5

  • Updated plugin package directory and text domain alignment.

3.2.2

  • Cleanup and hardening release.
  • Removed unused SMS/OTP hooks from the free build.
  • Fixed: previously saved Pro credentials are no longer readable after a Pro-to-Free downgrade.
  • Improved: Kitchen Display admin page layout.

3.2.1

  • Unified codebase: the Free version’s JS and CSS (newer, cleaner structure with improved state management) is now the shared base for both Free and Pro builds.
  • Fixed: Kitchen Display was missing from the admin sidebar — Yatoon Restaurant Menu → Kitchen Display is now always present.
  • Fixed: The Featured toggle (⭐) on the Menu Items admin page had no JavaScript event handler — items can now be featured/unfeatured without a page reload.
  • Improved: Admin Orders page now shows a status count dashboard (New / Preparing / Ready / Done), customer search, filter by status and fulfillment type, and full per-item modifier breakdown.
  • Improved: Freemius SDK updated from 2.13.0 to 2.13.1.
  • Improved: Plugin conflict detection deactivates more gracefully if Free and Pro are both activated at once.

3.2.0

  • Stabilized pay-at-restaurant ordering for pickup, delivery, and dine-in flows.
  • Added coupon code support (percent-off and fixed-amount rules, configurable minimum order).
  • Improved server-side modifier normalization and cart validation.
  • Added payment_method and payment_status columns to the orders table (future-proofs for Pro payments).
  • Added availability window support for time-limited menu items (e.g. lunch specials).
  • Improved release metadata and packaging for WordPress.org distribution.

3.1.0

  • Added native customer accounts using WordPress users — register, sign in, and sign out.
  • Added favorites (❤️) that persist across sessions.
  • Added order history and order-again support in the account slide-over panel.
  • Improved front-end account compatibility for sign-out, account data, and favorites.
  • Added [yatoon_order_status] shortcode for customer-facing order tracking by order number.
  • Improved admin order list with fulfillment type, pickup slot, and per-item modifier details.

3.0

  • Major rewrite from 2.x. Rebuilt ordering, cart, and checkout flows from scratch.
  • Added full Settings page: restaurant info, email templates, tip options, coupon rules, and appearance controls.
  • Added Kitchen Display ([yatoon_kitchen]) with auto-refresh and status action buttons.
  • Added featured items carousel, full-text search, sticky category navigation, and item modifier groups.
  • Added stock control, max-per-order limits, and availability windows per item.
  • Added tax rate, service fee, delivery fee, and configurable tip buttons.
  • Added activation protection to prevent conflicts when another Yatoon Restaurant Menu version is already active.
  • Added WordPress.org-compliant Upgrade to Pro notices in admin.

2.0.5

  • Updated front-end icon buttons to use white backgrounds with clean black SVG icons.
  • Replaced colored account and cart emoji icons with SVG icons.

2.0.4

  • Added activation guard to prevent fatal errors when another Yatoon Restaurant Menu package is already active.
  • Clarified Free vs Pro feature boundaries in admin notices and settings.

2.0.3

  • Rebuilt checkout flow with full server-side order validation and database storage.
  • Added native customer accounts, favorites, and order history.
  • Added coupons, modifiers, stock controls, and fulfillment type settings.

2.0.2

  • Moved inline scripts and styles to wp_add_inline_script / wp_add_inline_style.
  • Added External Services documentation to readme.txt.
  • Updated Plugin URI.

2.0.1

  • Fixed order placement database error.

2.0.0

  • Initial public release.
